lines.text: Find setups checks your list against conditions you pick, on closed candles.
Five steps: pick a list, pick a chart, pick a scan, run it, and read the results.
When you press Run, every condition narrows the list. A stock is a match only when it passes all of them.
The counts in this drawing are made up.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Now, what it does not do. A match is information: not a signal to trade, and not advice.
It does not rank stocks as good or bad, and it says nothing about what price does next.
It never places, changes or cancels an order. Every decision stays yours.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Open the ATP website on your phone or computer. You see the Sign in screen.
Where your team has set them up, sign-in buttons such as Continue with Google sit at the top.
Or type your email here.
Then your password.
Press Sign in. The app opens on Today.
Forgot your password? Tap Forgot password, and ATP sends a reset link.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
On a computer, Find setups is in the left menu, under Find. On a phone, tap it in the bar at the bottom.
Not in the bar? Tap More, and type scan in the search box.
Tap Find setups to open it.
The page opens: Find setups. Scan your list for the setups you pick.
If you see Coming soon instead, the screener is not switched on for your organisation yet. Ask your administrator.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
Here is a tour of the page, from top to bottom.
Your list: which stocks are scanned. Press Change to pick another list.
Chart: the size of one candle, for example Daily.
Start a scan: three ways in. A ready scan, a template, or your own words.
Conditions: the conditions of the current scan. It opens when you pick a scan.
Results: empty until your first run.
More tools holds the less used tools.
Browse all screens, Past runs, Rankings, Look back and Advanced. Each one shows only when it is switched on.
Your list, Chart, Start a scan, Conditions, Results. The next episode starts with your list.
Information and education only, not investment advice.
